message: ビッグブリッジな死闘

name: Misa
message: 「Hah... hah... With this, it's finally...」

name: Pasta
message: 「If you think it's over, you're dead wrong, nya.」

name: Ria
message: 「I knew it...\s02」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Let's stop this already. I do not wish to wound your pride or your body any further.」

name: Pasta
message: 「Acting like you've already won--there's a limit to how much you can mock me, nyaaa!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, none of your allies have any will left to fight, do they?」

name: Pasta
message: 「Nyahaha. Anticipating something like this might happen, I hired a mercenary in advance, nya.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「So you were totally expecting to lose, huh.」

name: Pasta
message: 「With this, I'll claim a grand victory, nya!! Now, come onnn.」

name: Eauderourke
message: 「Ode, appear.」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh!? Eauderourke!?」

name: Pasta
message: 「He's one of the Demon Generals just like Pasta, nya. ...Wait, how do you know Eauderourke, nya!?」

name: Synn
message: 「Eauderourke is one of our allies, you know...」

name: Pasta
message: 「Nyat!? What is the meaning of this, nya!! What did I treat you to beef bowls for, nya?!」

name: Eauderourke
message: 「Beef bowl, tasty. Repay, favor.」

name: Pasta
message: 「I knew it, nya. Being loyal is the mark of a good boy, nya.」

name: Misa
message: 「What happens to your promise with us?!」

name: Eauderourke
message: 「Ode, keep, promise.」

name: Ria
message: 「W-What's going on here?」

name: Pasta
message: 「Nyagaaa!! Let's crush the Crusaders together, nyaaa!!」
